purpose: One register for the whole application: what the learner sees, where it is implemented natively, where it is implemented on the server, what it persists, what proves it, and the measurable condition that makes it done.

boundaries.database_security: A parallel agent owns database/tenant security hardening. This register records the current expected path and the existing security tests, but makes no change to security code and does not claim that hardening is complete.
boundaries.rule: A row is only 'implemented' when all six elements are present and the cited test path exists. 'Partial' means the user-facing path exists but a listed element is incomplete. 'Absent' is a finding, not a TODO.

status_legend.implemented: User path, native path, backend path, data path and an automated test exist.
status_legend.partial: The feature runs, but one or more of the six elements is incomplete (for example no native surface, or no direct test).
status_legend.absent: No implementation exists; the register names the gap so it cannot be mistaken for done.
status_legend.external: Owned by another agent or outside this program; recorded for completeness, not claimed as verified here.

features.name: Account registration and launch gate
features.user_facing: Create an account with name, email and password; the launch gate requires the 13+ confirmation and acceptance of the Terms and Privacy Policy.
features.native: native/Sources/LearningHarness/LuminfestApp.swift — OnboardingView, register/sign-in segmented control, age and terms toggles.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py POST /api/v1/auth/register; backend/app/accounts.py; backend/app/security.py (Argon2 hashing, session issue).
features.data: db.py User (role, age_confirmed_at, terms_accepted_at, course_id, telemetry_consent) and ConsentLedger (terms/privacy rows).
features.tests: backend/tests/test_accounts.py; backend/tests/test_api.py registration cases; backend/tests/test_desktop_environment.py desktop 422/201 gate.
features.acceptance: Missing age_confirmed or accept_terms → 422; valid registration → 201 and a usable bearer token; duplicate email → 409; the first account on a local desktop instance is role=teacher.

features.name: Sign-in, refresh and sign-out
features.user_facing: Sign in with email/password; the session persists across launches; sign-out revokes the session.
features.native: native/Sources/LearningHarness/LuminfestApp.swift (auth form); native/Sources/LearningHarness/Core.swift (token/session calls); SessionVault.swift (Keychain store, currently not wired).
features.backend: backend/app/main.py POST /api/v1/auth/login, /auth/refresh, /auth/logout, /auth/sessions; backend/app/security.py rotate_refresh/revoke_session.
features.data: db.py Token (access token digest, TTL) and RefreshToken (rotation, reuse detection, revocation).
features.tests: backend/tests/test_accounts.py (login, refresh rotation, logout, session revocation); backend/tests/test_security_contract.py.
features.acceptance: Access token TTL is 3600 s; refresh rotates and the old refresh token is rejected; logout revokes the session; a revoked token gets 401.

features.name: First-run course setup
features.user_facing: Three-step setup: choose a course, state a goal (optional), choose daily minutes (5–90), then Start learning.
features.native: native/Sources/LearningHarness/CourseSetup.swift — subjectStep, goalStep, paceStep, setup.finish; native/Sources/LearningHarness/Core.swift saveSetup.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py PATCH /api/v1/me; backend/app/planner.py course pacing; backend/app/courses.py catalogue/enrolment.
features.data: db.py User.goal, User.daily_minutes, User.course_id; course graph packs.
features.acceptance: Start learning persists course_id, goal and daily_minutes; the Today page returns a plan with a non-zero budget; changing course later does not mix evidence across concepts.

features.name: Teacher/learner role separation
features.user_facing: A teacher account can use whiteboard, deck, simulation and authoring tools; a learner account gets a named refusal instead of a silent failure.
features.backend: backend/app/security.py principal(); backend/app/user_scope.py (tenant isolation); backend/app/harness/toolbox.py _require_teacher; backend/app/accounts.py _ensure_operator.
features.data: db.py User.role (learner/teacher/staff/admin).
features.acceptance: A learner calling a teacher-facing tool gets ok=false with a refusal that names the remedy; a teacher succeeds; server role is re-derived from the principal, never from model arguments.

features.name: Email verification and password reset
features.user_facing: The account model and token routes exist, but the shipped mailer is inert/offline; the desktop build cannot email a verification link or a reset link.
features.native: No dedicated verification/reset UI; OnboardingView shows the auth form only.
features.backend: backend/app/accounts.py send_verification; backend/app/security.py issue_auth_token/consume_auth_token; AuthToken table; mailer transport defaults offline.
features.data: db.py AuthToken (purpose, digest, expiry, consumed_at).
features.tests: backend/tests/test_accounts.py (token lifecycle where present); no end-to-end mail transport test.
features.acceptance: If a transport is configured: verification/reset token is single-use, expires, and a reset changes the password; currently the honest status is 'unavailable without a mail transport', not 'delivered'.

features.name: Course catalogue and enrolment
features.user_facing: Browse courses, see size and authored share, switch course from Settings, and keep evidence separated per course.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py GET /api/v1/courses, /courses/{id}; backend/app/courses.py; enrolled_course() in main.py.
features.data: Curriculum packs under backend/app/curriculum_packs; db.py User.course_id.
features.acceptance: The default catalogue returns the authored mathematics course; enrolling changes the map and practice items; switching back restores prior evidence without mixing concept ids.

features.name: Knowledge graph and prerequisite order
features.user_facing: The Knowledge map shows concepts by strand/unit/depth, prerequisites, and what each concept unlocks.
features.native: native/Sources/LearningHarness/TodayKnowledge.swift — KnowledgeView, graph search, depth explanation, graph.openLesson.
features.backend: backend/app/knowledge_graph.py; backend/app/courses.py graph_for(); backend/app/main.py GET /api/v1/knowledge-graph and /knowledge-graph/{concept_id}.

features.acceptance: Integrated Mathematics I exposes 164 concepts and 183 edges; every lesson node resolves to a graph node; prerequisite chains are acyclic; a concept with no lesson is labeled rather than hidden.

features.name: Course generation from source
features.user_facing: Paste text, a URL or a file and generate a course; the native app has no course-creation screen, so this runs through the web workbench's Course Studio.

features.name: Authored versus generated content honesty
features.user_facing: The lesson says whether it is hand-authored, generated from a course map, or has no lesson; missing content is a named gap, never an invented lesson.

features.data: Authored lesson packs; generated course packs; concept metadata.
features.acceptance: The course reports 30 authored of 164 graph nodes; a generated lesson carries a generated-tier label and its source; a concept with no lesson returns the named gap and does not claim a lesson.

features.name: Lesson reader and sections
features.user_facing: Read a lesson as sections with headings, concept blocks, worked examples, retrieval prompts and a reading rail.

features.acceptance: Every block kind in a lesson renders without raw markdown; section changes preserve the selected concept; reading a lesson does not change mastery.

features.name: Lesson procedure compiler
features.user_facing: Today shows a run of show for the concept; the learner starts it, completes or skips blocks, and sees why activities were refused.

features.name: Question serving and answer submission
features.user_facing: Answer a multiple-choice or written question, state confidence, submit once, and receive feedback or an exam-withheld state.
features.native: native/Sources/LearningHarness/QuestionView.swift — option/text input, confidence slider, Submit answer, retry-frozen-answer; Core.swift submitAnswer.

features.acceptance: An attempt without a valid receipt is refused; a duplicate client_event_id does not create a second attempt; a scored attempt writes an Attempt row; the response identifies the correct answer/explanation when feedback is allowed.

features.name: Diagnosis and mastery update
features.user_facing: Feedback names the kind of error (concept, calculation or procedure) and shows an estimated mastery only after real work.
features.native: native/Sources/LearningHarness/QuestionView.swift feedback card (diagnosis, mastery, review date); Core.swift question state.
features.backend: backend/app/learning.py; backend/app/psychometrics.py; backend/app/curriculum.py diagnosis triples; backend/app/memory.py FSRS update.
features.data: db.py State (mastery, mastery_known, stability, difficulty, due_at) and Attempt.
features.acceptance: Before any attempt, mastery_known=false and the prior 0.15 is not displayed as the learner's mastery; after a scored attempt, mastery_known=true and the state's due date is scheduled; the diagnosis is specific, not generic.

features.name: Shared whiteboard and tutor drawing
features.user_facing: The Stage whiteboard shows the tutor's drawing and the learner's ink; the tutor can draw when asked, and the learner can ask about a selection.

features.name: Deck, shipped images and 45-minute auto-lecture
features.user_facing: Generate an editable narrated deck with real credited images; run a 45-minute lecture that auto-advances, speaks, turns pages, draws a board page and shows an image or video.
features.backend: backend/app/routes_deck.py /deck/from-concept and .pptx export; backend/app/lecture.py /lecture preview/start/segment; backend/app/media_packs/image_seed.json + images; backend/app/harness/media.py shipped_for.

features.acceptance: A deck exports valid OOXML; a shipped image carries title/credit/licence and is served from /media/images/{sha}/bytes; a lecture has 9–16 segments (model path 15–16; deterministic fallback 9), sums to 2700 s, every segment has board_ops, and at least one image and one video slot; a media refusal returns a reference card, not a fake file.

features.name: Grounded flashcard generation
features.user_facing: Generate flashcards for a concept; each card has a front, back, hint and provenance; generation is idempotent.
features.native: native/Sources/LearningHarness/Flashcards.swift — deck list, generate, review controls; Core.swift flashcard calls.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py /api/v1/flashcards/generate and /flashcards; backend/app/flashcards.py source_exists.
features.data: db.py Flashcard (front, back, hint, tags, source JSON, front_key, unique user/concept/front_key).
features.tests: backend/tests/test_flashcards.py — grounded provenance, misconception card, idempotence, no-provenance 422.
features.acceptance: A generated card with a dangling source is refused; a card without provenance returns 422; generating the same concept twice does not duplicate rows; every persisted card's source resolves to a real block, question or concept.

features.name: FSRS-6 review scheduling
features.user_facing: Review a card with Again/Hard/Good/Easy; the next due date changes according to the rating.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py /flashcards/{id}/review; backend/app/memory.py FSRS-6 DSR update; /flashcards/session.
features.data: db.py Flashcard due_at, stability, difficulty, reps, lapses, last_review_at, last_grade, state.
features.acceptance: Good schedules a later due_at than Again for the same starting state; a grade outside 1..4 returns 422; after a review, reps increments and due_at > now; the session never serves a card twice in one pass.

features.name: Daily review queue
features.user_facing: Today/Review shows cards due now, starts a review session, and explains an empty queue instead of inventing work.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py GET /api/v1/reviews and /flashcards/session; backend/app/memory.py due selection.
features.data: db.py Flashcard.due_at; db.py State for concept-level review dates.
features.acceptance: Only cards with due_at ≤ now are served; an empty queue renders the named empty state; a session interleaves two concepts when both are due; no review row is created merely by opening the page.

features.name: Flashcard import and export
features.user_facing: Export the deck as JSON or CSV and import it back without losing front/back/source.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py /flashcards/export and /flashcards/import; backend/app/flashcards.py.
features.data: db.py Flashcard.
features.acceptance: JSON and CSV exports round-trip front/back/source; duplicate fronts are deduplicated by front_key; import of a malformed row returns a named error rather than a partial silent write.

features.name: Diagnostic and calibration
features.user_facing: Start a short diagnostic; after enough calibrated items the app shows a level instead of a guess.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py GET /questions/next?mode=diagnostic and /assessments; backend/app/psychometrics.py CAT/IRT; backend/app/leveling.py.
features.data: db.py Assessment (mode/total/answered/correct/complete) and Attempt.
features.acceptance: With 0 calibrated items, /ability returns known=false and label='Not yet measured'; a level appears only after at least 5 calibrated items; the response says the level is not certified.

features.name: Practice exam and scoring
features.user_facing: Take a practice exam; feedback is withheld until the exam ends; a final score and item breakdown appear.
features.native: native/Sources/LearningHarness/QuestionView.swift exam mode and feedback; Core.swift requestFinishQuestion.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py POST /assessments/exam/end and /attempts; backend/app/exam_guard.py.
features.data: db.py Assessment and Attempt; Receipt for issued items.
features.acceptance: Exam answers are stored but correctness is withheld until exam end; the final score equals correct/total; ending an exam marks it abandoned/complete exactly once; a second end is idempotent.

features.name: Ability estimate and level card
features.user_facing: See theta/SE, CEFR/grade after calibration, and an explicit 'not certified' note.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py GET /api/v1/ability; backend/app/psychometrics.py; backend/app/leveling.py cefr_from_theta/grade_from_theta.
features.data: db.py State and Attempt.
features.acceptance: theta and SE are finite; SE shrinks as calibrated attempts increase; CEFR/grade are null before 5 items; the card never presents a prior as a measurement.

features.name: Unit-level gradebook against declared standards
features.user_facing: Per-unit standards with per-standard evidence counts, a percentage only when every declared standard has enough graded attempts, and a frozen grade record. The UI says "NO GRADE YET" instead of showing an average over the easy half of the syllabus.
features.backend: backend/app/assessment_book.py (units_of, evaluate, UnitGrade); main.py GET /api/v1/gradebook, GET /api/v1/gradebook/{unit_key}, POST /api/v1/gradebook/{unit_key}/grade.
features.data: unit_grades table: frozen standards snapshot, score, max_score, percent, standards_met/total, attempt count, scope_note. Scored from Attempt rows filtered by main.graded_attempts.
features.tests: backend/tests/test_assessment_and_perspectives.py — declares standards, refuses a grade with no evidence, refuses a grade with partial evidence, freezes once, upserts rather than duplicating, and hides another course’s unit.
features.acceptance: A unit with any standard below 2 graded attempts has percent=null and POST /grade returns 409 with the missing standards; once every standard has evidence a frozen grade is stored and re-grading updates the same row. Remaining delta: standards are this course’s declared objectives, not external academic standards (Common Core/AP alignment), and the grade is explicitly formative and non-accredited.

features.name: Project brief, submission and rubric
features.user_facing: Open a project brief, submit text with an AI-use disclosure and reflection, and receive formative rubric feedback.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py GET /api/v1/projects and POST /projects/{id}/submit; backend/app/curriculum.py project rubric.
features.data: db.py Project (status, submission, feedback, ai_disclosure, reflection).
features.tests: backend/tests/test_api.py project cases; backend/tests/test_harness.py whole-use cases.
features.acceptance: Submission requires ≥10 characters of text, a non-empty AI disclosure and a non-empty reflection; missing fields return 422; a valid submission sets status=submitted and returns rubric evidence; the rubric never claims correctness it did not check.

features.name: Course authoring from source
features.user_facing: Create a course from pasted text, a URL or a file; the native shell header's 'Create a course' sheet now builds a course from pasted notes and can enrol in it. URL/file sources remain a web-workbench path.
features.native: native/Sources/LearningHarness/CourseAuthoring.swift (CourseAuthoringSheet), opened from LuminfestApp.swift (course.create); first-person journey J6 in NativeQA.swift. web/index.html Course Studio for URL/file sources.
features.backend: backend/app/routes_create.py; backend/app/course_builder.py; /create/preview, /create/course, /create/search.
features.data: Created course packs and lesson records in the local store.
features.tests: backend/tests/test_course_builder.py; backend/tests/test_creation_tools.py; backend/tests/test_source_extension.py; native/Sources/LearningHarness/NativeQA.swift journey J6 (real AX controls).
features.acceptance: Same source → same course (determinism); refusals name the missing structure and actual counts; a URL fetch rejects private/loopback destinations and revalidates each redirect; native preview saves nothing, create returns the owned course id, enrol reloads the plan.

features.name: Lesson authoring and the foundry
features.user_facing: Draft, extend and validate a lesson; inspect the authored-versus-generated overlay.
features.backend: backend/app/routes_authoring.py; backend/app/authoring_overlay.py; backend/app/harness/toolbox.py authoring tools.
features.data: Authoring overlay bundles and lesson packs.
features.acceptance: A draft validates against the lesson schema; a missing block is named; generated text is labeled and never presented as hand-authored; an overlay write is versioned or refused.

features.name: Unit projects with submission, rubric and AI disclosure
features.user_facing: A project per concept with a written submission, a reflection, an explicit AI-use disclosure, the unit rubric, and formative feedback. Drafts survive leaving the page; observations can be attached to the real artifact.
features.native: native/Sources/LearningHarness/ProjectsInsightsSettings.swift — ProjectsView and ProjectEditor; ProjectDrafts.swift keeps per-account drafts; AssessmentInsights.swift — PerspectiveCard attaches an observation to a real project.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py GET /api/v1/projects and POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/submit; backend/app/perspectives.py anchors observations to the Project row.
features.data: projects table (submission, feedback, ai_disclosure, reflection, status); perspective_reviews table anchors written observations to a project id.
features.tests: backend/tests/test_assessment_and_perspectives.py — a self-review is refused for an invented artifact and accepted for a real project; test_api.py covers project submission; test_account_deletion.py covers erasure.
features.acceptance: A learner can write, keep a draft, submit, disclose AI use, read the rubric and feedback, and attach a written perspective observation. Remaining delta: no camera capture or on-camera presentation recording, and no teacher-scored certified grade; the feedback explicitly says it is a formative rubric checklist, not a correctness claim.

features.name: Classic tutor chat and fallback
features.user_facing: Ask the tutor a question; the reply is formatted, persisted, and labeled with the provider that actually answered.

features.data: db.py Message (role, content, provider, concept_id, session_id).
features.acceptance: A turn persists one user and one assistant message; the assistant row's provider matches the answer path; a provider failure returns 200 with grounded offline content and a truthful provider label; no empty bubble is stored.

features.name: Agentic tool loop and activity trace
features.user_facing: The tutor can call tools (draw, search, build) and the chat shows human-readable activity chips while it works.
features.native: native/Sources/LearningHarness/Studio.swift TutorPanel; Core.swift serverEvents/agent stream; activity chips.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py /api/v1/agent/chat and /agent/stream; backend/app/harness/agent_loop.py; backend/app/harness/toolbox.py (51 tools).

features.name: Text-to-speech through VoiceStudio
features.user_facing: Ask the tutor to speak; audio plays from the local VoiceStudio voice, and the UI says which engine is speaking.

features.name: Duplex voice (OpenAI Realtime)

features.name: First-party playground catalogue

features.acceptance: With too little interaction, reading.state='unclear' with a reason; a streak counts only days with real practice; attention/fatigue never punish or ban.

features.name: Multi-perspective analytics from written rubric evidence
features.user_facing: Five perspective dimensions (participation, communication, creativity, collaboration, soft skills) with a published measurement definition beside each number. A learner writes a self-observation on a real project; a teacher records group observations; either can be withdrawn.
features.native: native/Sources/LearningHarness/AssessmentInsights.swift — PerspectiveCard; InsightsView renders every analytics dimension; AppStore+Assessment.swift — recordSelfObservation, withdrawObservation.
features.backend: backend/app/perspectives.py (DIMENSIONS, validate_observation, summary, public_definitions); main.py GET /api/v1/perspectives, GET /api/v1/perspectives/dimensions, POST/DELETE /api/v1/perspectives/reviews; analytics_data() includes the rows.
features.data: perspective_reviews table: subject, real artifact anchor, dimension, 0-4 score, written evidence note, reviewer role, group size, timestamps. Unique per (subject, artifact, dimension, reviewer).
features.tests: backend/tests/test_assessment_and_perspectives.py — empty dimensions are null not zero, short notes and invented artifacts are refused, learners cannot score another learner, collaboration requires a teacher-recorded group observation, withdrawal works, export and erasure cover the rows; test_api.py/test_final_contract.py still pin Cognitive attention as the last dimension with value null.
features.acceptance: No observation means value=null and status insufficient_evidence/not_measured, never a percentage derived from foreground activity. Cognitive attention remains explicitly not measured. A 409/422 is returned for an invented artifact, a bare score, or a cross-account self-review. Limitation: these are human judgements with written evidence, not validated psychometric instruments; collaboration has no direct peer-to-peer surface, only teacher-recorded group observations.

features.name: Usage and metering ledger
features.user_facing: Operator-facing usage/cost accounting for tutor turns and provider fallbacks.
features.native: No learner-facing cost screen; operator data is served by the API.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py usage/ledger routes; backend/app/accounts.py record_usage; backend/app/harness/provider.py meter_usage.
features.data: db.py UsageLedger, UsageDailyRollup, QuotaCounter.
features.acceptance: Every tutor turn writes one UsageLedger row, including offline fallback with outcome=fallback and zero tokens; latency and provider/model are recorded; a failed write does not silently disappear.

features.name: Age and terms gate
features.user_facing: Registration requires the 13+ confirmation and acceptance of Terms and Privacy; the consent is recorded.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py /auth/register; backend/app/config.py require_launch_gate; backend/app/legal_guard.py.
features.data: db.py User.age_confirmed_at, terms_accepted_at, terms_version; ConsentLedger.
features.acceptance: Missing either declaration → 422; valid → 201; terms_version is stored; the desktop build requires the gate; legal documents are served and contain no placeholders.

features.name: Interaction telemetry consent
features.user_facing: Activity tracking is off by default; enabling it is explicit and can be revoked; the app says it does not track screen/keystrokes/other apps.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py PATCH /me and POST /events; backend/app/harness/telemetry.py (closed grammar, EVIDENCE=False).
features.data: db.py User.telemetry_consent, TelemetryEvent.
features.acceptance: Default consent is false; /events returns 403 without consent; payloads accept only click/tap/key/blur/focus with no key value and no window title; telemetry never counts as learning evidence.

features.name: Model-training consent
features.user_facing: A separate opt-in controls whether responses may be used for model improvement; activity consent does not imply it.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py POST /training/consent and /training/status; backend/app/training.py.
features.data: db.py TrainingConsent, ConsentLedger.
features.acceptance: Training consent defaults off and is independent of telemetry; only opted-in pseudonymized rows are exported; no live training or unlearning guarantee is claimed.

features.name: Outbound media disclosure
features.user_facing: Image/video search is disclosed; the desktop build may contact Openverse, the Met, Wikimedia, NASA and YouTube; production is opt-in.
features.native: No extra toggle; search runs when the feature requests media.
features.backend: backend/app/config.py media_enabled; backend/app/harness/media.py; backend/app/harness/video_search.py; backend/legal/privacy.md; DISTRIBUTION.md.
features.data: No learner identifier is sent; cached asset carries licence/attribution.
features.acceptance: Desktop media_enabled=true and privacy.md names the providers; production defaults off; a search sends a query, not an identity; an unclassified licence is refused.

features.name: Data minimisation and tenant isolation
features.user_facing: One learner cannot read another learner's boards, flashcards, messages or progress; sensitive fields are not collected.
features.native: No cross-account UI; the client only reads the authenticated account.
features.backend: backend/app/user_scope.py USER_SCOPED_TABLES/UnsafeQueryError; backend/app/security.py; backend/app/db.py foreign keys. Database-security hardening is owned by the parallel security agent.
features.data: All user-scoped tables; unscoped() requires a non-empty reason and is audited.
features.acceptance: Every user-scoped query is scoped or fails closed; a board/flashcard/message owned by another account returns 404, not 403; no content, key value or window title is stored. This row is recorded, not claimed as security-complete.

features.name: Account export
features.user_facing: Settings → Export data writes a JSON file of the learner's own records.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py GET /api/v1/export; backend/app/user_scope.py.
features.data: All user-scoped rows (profile, states, attempts, messages, flashcards, projects, runs); password hashes, token digests and secrets excluded.
features.acceptance: Export returns JSON with the learner's rows; a second account's data is absent; password_hash/token digests/refresh tokens are absent; the file opens and parses as JSON.

features.name: Account deletion
features.user_facing: Settings → Delete account requires typing DELETE MY ACCOUNT and permanently removes the account.
features.backend: backend/app/main.py DELETE /api/v1/me; backend/app/account_erasure.py; foreign-key cascades.
features.data: All user-scoped rows and owned media; no orphan rows.
features.acceptance: Wrong confirmation → 422; correct phrase → 204; the account and its dependent rows are gone; a second delete returns 401/404; no orphan board/flashcard/message remains.

features.name: Database backup and restore
features.user_facing: Operator-facing backup/restore with an integrity manifest; not exposed as a learner button.
features.backend: backend/app/database_backup.py; backend/scripts/init_db.py migration/backup.
features.data: SQLite database plus SHA-256 manifest; WAL-safe copy.
features.acceptance: A backup passes PRAGMA integrity_check and a SHA-256 manifest check; restore reproduces the database; a corrupt/truncated backup is refused; a migration takes a pre-migration backup.

features.name: Cached media deletion
features.user_facing: Deleting an account removes its cached images/audio; the learner is not told a file remains.
features.backend: backend/app/account_erasure.py; backend/app/harness/media.py cache; backend/app/routes_media.py.
features.data: data_dir/media/images.jsonl and image/audio files.
features.tests: backend/tests/test_media_pipeline.py; test_database_backup.py; no dedicated cache-erasure assertion.
features.acceptance: After account deletion, the user's cached media manifests/files are gone; export includes the licence metadata; a shared shipped pack is not deleted. Currently the account path exists but a direct cache-erasure test is missing.

features.name: Bundled backend and local database
features.user_facing: The desktop app launches its own loopback backend and local SQLite database; no hosted service is required.
features.backend: backend/desktop_entry.py; backend/app/config.py HARNESS_ENV=desktop; backend/app/db.py SQLite; packaging freeze.
features.data: ~/Library/Application Support/Luminfest Learning Harness/harness.sqlite3.
features.acceptance: Cold start reaches /health ready:true within 120 s; no PostgreSQL or external DB is required; the bundle contains the feature routes; a stale endpoint does not suppress spawning the bundled backend.

features.name: Offline tutor fallback
features.user_facing: With no model key or provider failure, the tutor answers from the curriculum and says so instead of showing an empty bubble.
features.backend: backend/app/harness/provider.py (never raises, returns None); backend/app/tutor.py offline_answer(); backend/app/main.py fallback turn.
features.data: db.py Message.provider = grounded-offline; UsageLedger outcome=fallback.
features.acceptance: provider unset or HTTP 402 → 200 with a grounded curriculum answer and a label naming the fallback; no empty content is persisted; the attempt is metered as fallback.

features.name: Shipped media and curated video
features.user_facing: Decks and lectures still have real pictures and a curated video when the network is unavailable.
features.backend: backend/app/media_packs/image_seed.json + images; backend/app/media_packs/video_allowlist_seed.json; backend/app/harness/media.py shipped_for; backend/app/harness/video.py allowlist.
features.data: 107 curated image rows with sha256/credit/licence; curated video allowlist rows.
features.acceptance: The shipped pack contains 107 images with bytes; a deck for a covered concept returns a real image with attribution offline; a missing concept returns a named gap, not a decorative placeholder; a curated video is embed-verified.

features.name: No-network media behavior
features.user_facing: When outbound media is disabled or the network is down, the lesson says why and still runs with text, figures and curated assets.
features.backend: backend/app/harness/media.py enabled()/network_disabled; backend/app/harness/media.py find_image; backend/app/harness/video_search.py.
features.data: No asset row is written on refusal.
features.acceptance: media_enabled=false → outcome network_disabled with a reason; no download is attempted; the deterministic figure/deck remains available; a failed search does not produce a fake asset.

features.name: Voice dependency and fallback
features.user_facing: If VoiceStudio is not running, speech says so and the app can fall back to the Mac voice; the tutor text still works.
features.backend: backend/app/harness/speech.py; backend/app/harness/voice.py; POST /voice/speak.
features.data: No database row; cached audio under data_dir/media/audio.
features.acceptance: VoiceStudio absent → 503 with a named reason; the Mac voice fallback still reads the lesson; text chat is unaffected; a missing voice never blocks a lesson.

features.name: Rewards and celebration
features.user_facing: Milestones and streaks produce a celebration overlay; rewards are recognition, not a substitute for mastery.
features.backend: backend/app/routes_rewards.py; backend/app/harness/teaching/motivation.py; /api/v1/rewards/events.
features.data: db.py State and reward/streak fields; no reward row may substitute for an Attempt.
features.acceptance: A reward event is idempotent; a streak ends but is never taken away as punishment; a celebration cannot raise mastery; a learner with no real practice gets no invented streak.

features.name: Browser window stream
features.user_facing: A teacher can open the running desktop window in a browser tab and send input back; the page is a window into the app, not a second frontend.
features.backend: backend/app/routes_stream.py; /api/v1/stream/status|frame|window|input|enable; macOS screen-capture and Accessibility permissions.
features.data: No database row; frame/window state is ephemeral.
features.acceptance: Off by default and teacher-only; learner gets 403; missing Screen Recording/Accessibility returns a named reason, not a black canvas; measured rate is ~4 fps. A hosted production instance refuses to enable it.

features.name: Localization, theme and accessibility
features.user_facing: Language switching, dark/high-contrast themes, reduced motion and larger text; navigation is localized, while most lesson prose remains English.
features.backend: backend/app/content_locale.py (content locale metadata); no server-side UI rendering.
features.data: User preferences (locale/theme) in UserPreference or app defaults.
features.tests: backend/tests/test_content_locale.py; native UI/theme tests where present. A parallel agent is actively changing this surface on feature/a11y-i18n.
features.acceptance: A chosen language/theme persists; text scaling does not clip primary controls; reduced motion disables decorative canvases; the current build's localization coverage is partial (80 keys, mostly navigation/settings), so this row is recorded as external until that agent's work lands.
